meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

copy.tagline: 将频道连接到代理组并管理隔离级别
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理多个频道与代理组的映射关系
copy.tagline_en: Wire channels to agent groups and manage isolation levels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage mappings between channels and agent groups

howto.what: 装上后，Claude可以管理消息渠道与代理组之间的连线，包括添加新渠道、修改现有连接、查看配置并处理隔离级别。它会引导你完成渠道注册和组创建。
howto.when: 在添加新渠道后、初始设置期间，或单独重新配置时触发。典型场景包括初始化第一个代理组、添加新渠道（如Telegram群组）等。

say.text: 帮我查看当前的渠道连接情况。
say.note: 显示代理组、连接渠道及特权用户摘要。

say.text: 我想把新创建的Discord频道连接到现有代理组。
say.note: 引导你完成注册步骤，包括隔离选择。

say.text: 请检查是否有遗留的WhatsApp群组配置问题。
say.note: 运行一次性检查并询问是否修复。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to manage connections between messaging channels and agent groups, including adding new channels, modifying existing wirings, viewing configuration, and handling isolation levels. It guides through channel registration and group creation.
howto.when_en: Triggered after adding a channel, during initial setup, or standalone to reconfigure. Typical entry points: initializing the first agent group, adding a new channel (e.g., Telegram group), or adjusting existing wirings.

say_en.text: Show me the current channel connections.
say_en.note: Displays summary of agent groups, wirings, and privileged users.

say_en.text: I want to connect a new Discord channel to an existing agent group.
say_en.note: Walks through registration including isolation question.

say_en.text: Check for legacy WhatsApp group misconfigurations.
say_en.note: Runs one-time check and offers repair options.
